title: Staff
intro: Everyone who signs in to your organization, and the role that decides what each of them may do.
empty: Nobody else is here yet. Add the people who work with you.

create.title: Add staff
create.description: Give them an email, a username or both. Staff without email sign in with your organization code and their username.
create.name: Full name
create.emailHint: Optional. They can sign in with it and reset their own password.
create.usernameHint: Optional. 2-32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
create.phoneHint: Optional. Only for your own records and exports: it is not a sign-in name.
create.temporaryPasswordHint: They choose their own password the first time they sign in.
create.handover: Give {name} these details to sign in:
create.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

form.usernameInvalid: Use 2-32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
form.emailOrUsername: Give an email, a username or both.

changeRole.title: Change {name}'s role
changeRole.description: The new role applies from their next action.

changePhone.title: Change {name}'s phone
changePhone.description: Leave it empty to remove the number. It is not a sign-in name, and the audit log never keeps it.
changePhone.label: Phone

problems.required: Use a phone number like 98765 43210, or leave it empty.
problems.invalid: Use a phone number like 98765 43210, or leave it empty.

resetPassword.title: Reset {name}'s password
resetPassword.description: They are signed out everywhere and must choose a new password with this temporary one.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: They are signed out at once and can't sign in again. What they did stays in your records.

import.title: Import staff
import.intro: Each row becomes a person who can sign in. Nothing is added until you press Add.

adding.title: Adding people
adding.intro: Adding the people from {name}. It takes a few seconds.
adding.label: Adding people

match.manyRoleValues: {column} has more than 50 different values. We match them to your roles by name; any we can't match aren't added.
match.roleNotMatched: Not matched: these rows aren't added
match.roleForAllHint: The file has no Role column, so everyone gets this role.
match.roleForBlankHint: Optional. A row with an empty Role cell gets this role.

check.intro: Here's what will happen to each of the {count} rows. Nothing is added until you press Add.
check.nothingToAdd: No row can be added. Change the columns, or fix the file and choose it again.
check.seats: Adds {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}: your plan has {free} seats free.
check.overSeats: This file adds {count} people, and your plan has {free} seats free. Leave some rows out, or <link>ask us about more seats</link>.
check.add: Add {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
check.confirmTitle: Add {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}?
check.confirmBody: Each gets a temporary password, shown once on the next screen.
check.returned: Nobody was added: {reason}. Check the list and press Add again.

done.title: {count, plural, one {# person added} other {# people added}}
done.neverKept: They can't be shown again: we never keep them.
done.name: Name
done.firstSignIn: Each person chooses their own password when they first sign in, with the organization code {code}.

lost.shownOnce: These passwords were shown once. If the sheet was lost, give new ones to everyone who hasn't signed in yet.
lost.everyoneSignedIn: These passwords were shown once. Everyone added has signed in and chosen their own.
lost.make: Make new passwords for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
lost.skipped: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} chose their own password meanwhile and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} left alone.

export.title: Export staff
export.intro: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}, with their roles and joined dates.
